page.layout: One column of running text; a handwritten mark at the right margin (not transcribed); page number top right; signature at foot left.

main_text.p: @Gemacoda, Concinnabat] Affine nostratium to make, à Sax. ȝemacian, facere.
@Geminsoda, Diminuit] Diminutio, Saxonibus minyunȝ, nobis mincing: ut cibus frustatim, & minutim concifus, nobis mincedmeat, alias mincemeat.

@Segiroda, Paravit] Superiùs ad @Gi-ʒo notatis, hîc adde, quòd vestimentum, amictus, Saxonibus ȝyplan, ȝeȝyplan; unde eis mnunc ȝeȝyplan, pro habitu, sive apparatu monachico, Bedæ, Caracalla: item vestimenta ecclesiastica, eis cyncean, ȝeȝynela; @Geare, etiam in Scotorum @Gaoes & @Geare, pro bonis & supelleƈtile, quemadmodum in nostratium nigbt-geare, bead-geare, id est, nocturnali, capitali, apparatu, huc, ni fallor, referendum.
@Gssatundon, Acceleraverunt] Citò, confestim, Sax. pona, nobis soone.

page.notes: Marginal handwritten marks at the right edge and a faded red-brown stain; some Old English glosses are in black letter and approximate. Doubtful readings: "Ƣlt-" catchword and the partly obscured letters in several Saxon glosses.
